truth (issue #1118): every handler reaches requestSave(), directly (doSetpoint), through a helper chain
(doMode -> applyMode -> afterWrite -> requestSave) or because its caller saves after it (doRange calls
writeRange, which only writes, then requestSave()). No row.
-- args --
@DIR@/Mod
-- want --
exit 0
-- stderr --
-- Mod/Mod-ux/src/com/x/ux/BDashServlet.java --
package com.x.ux;
public final class BDashServlet extends BWebServlet {
  void requestSave() {
    saveTicket = Clock.schedule(station, delay, BStation.save, null);
  }
  void doSetpoint(BComponent point, BValue v, Context cx) {
    point.set("out", v, cx);
    requestSave();
  }
  void doMode(BComponent point, BValue v, Context cx) {
    applyMode(point, v, cx);
  }
  private void applyMode(BComponent point, BValue v, Context cx) {
    point.set("mode", v, cx);
    afterWrite();
  }
  private void afterWrite() { requestSave(); }
  void doRange(BComponent day, BValue v, Context cx) {
    writeRange(day, v, cx);
    requestSave();
  }
  private void writeRange(BComponent day, BValue v, Context cx) { day.add(v, cx); }
}
